source_uncertainties: All assigned timestamped machine transcript text read sequentially; no full audiovisual review claimed.
Machine technical recognition is fallible; formulas are checked by derivation, primary references, and selected frames.
The partition function traces the unnormalized Boltzmann operator, not the normalized density state.
The zero-temperature singlet conclusion is restricted by field strength.
Matrix change under partial transpose does not itself certify entanglement; positivity is the criterion.
A parallelogram needs independent parameters; weights constrained to sum one give a segment.
Bell partial-transpose eigenvalues retain the factor one half.
General low-dimensional sufficiency is cited, not proved; the noise-family boundary has an explicit product decomposition.
